description: Guest reviews for one hotel from the last 24 months (up to 1,000, newest first), via Staylist's booking partner LiteAPI (Nuitée booking guests and Tripadvisor). Returns how many were 1–2 star (a score of 4 or less out of 10) and the texts of those bad reviews, so the traveler can see what went wrong for other guests before booking; with only_bad=false also the most recent reviews of any score. Quote or summarise faithfully, say how many reviews the count is out of, and do not present a few bad reviews as typical when they are a small share. Reviewer names are not included. available=false means no reviews from this source; nearby_with_reviews then lists close hotels (ids, km) whose reviews can be read instead. Also returns staylist_page (the hotel's page, where the reviews open) and booking_links (the same links as get_booking_link).

hotel_id.description: Exact hotel id returned by search_hotels

only_bad.description: Default true: only the 1–2 star reviews

name: get_reviews
title: Read guest reviews, including the bad ones
